findings.summary: zip: Critical Parser Differential & Security Control Bypass via Dual-Header Inconsistencies (Zip Cloaking) Leading to Arbitrary File Overwrite & RCE
ZipStreamReader::extract() and ZipArchive::extract() apply Unix permissions through symlinks without confining the target

evidence: the project's source does not use ZipStreamReader::extract, ZipArchive::extract, but other packages depend on zip

findings.summary: zip: Unbounded Symlink-Target Handling Can Abort Or Exhaust Memory During Extraction
Insecure Preservation of SUID/SGID Bits during ZIP Extraction Leading to Potential Privilege Escalation
decode-uri-component vulnerable to denial of service via quadratic replacement of percent-encoded runs
Drizzle ORM has SQL injection via improperly escaped SQL identifiers
image-size: JXL and HEIF parsers allow denial of service through infinite loops
image-size: ICNS parser allows denial of service through an infinite loop
Forge: X.509 basicConstraints bypass in verifyCertificateChain() via deprecated extension OIDs 2.5.29.10 and 2.5.29.13
Forge: RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 signature forgery via non-canonical DigestInfo encoding
Forge: Regular expression denial of service in PEM decoding (pem.decode)
node-forge RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 signature verification accepts extra nested DigestAlgorithm elements
Forge: Denial of service in TLS record processing via a record interleaved with a fragmented handshake message
Forge: Denial of service in TLS record processing via call stack exhaustion
Forge: PKCS#12 MAC forgery and constant-key PBE via zero iteration count
Forge: ASN.1 resource exhaustion via BIT STRING decoding in asn1.fromDer
Nodemailer: Quadratic (O(n²)) time complexity in addressparser allows remote denial of service via a crafted address list
Nodemailer: Message-level raw option bypasses disableFileAccess/disableUrlAccess, enabling arbitrary file read and full-response SSRF in the delivered message
Nodemailer: Quadratic backtracking in the addressparser free-text fallback allows remote denial of service
Zod can exhaust memory while validating oversized constrained collections
